newsitem.title: USA: Miller names Miller, Badgley co-CEOs.
newsitem.headline: Miller names Miller, Badgley co-CEOs.

text.p: Miller Industries Inc said Tuesday that William Miller and Jeffrey Badgley had been elected co-chief executive officers.
Miller will remain chairman of the board and Badgley will remain president.
The company said Miller has agreed to a three-year employment contract under which he will serve as chairman and co-CEO.

Miller has served since the founding of the company without an employment contract. The board requested that he formalize his working relationship with the company to more clearly reflect his long-term commitment.
